sub_locations.name: House of Marimmal Theer
sub_locations.description: Home of actor and impressario [[Marimmal Theer]] in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: House of Thammas Thous
sub_locations.description: The home of [[Thammas Thoul]], a collector, merchant, and an ex-slaver in there late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Pimlico Estate
sub_locations.description: Home of [[Pimlico]], a rich collector of rare [[book]]s in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Deril Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of a wealthy and powerful [[conjurer]] [[Deril]], who was served by a powerful [[lich]] as his butler in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Delryn Estate
sub_locations.description: The marge mansion of the noble [[Delryn]] family of [[Amn]]. The patriarch of the family was [[Cor Delryn]] in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Firecam Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of the [[Keldorn]] family, led by [[Keldorn Firecam]] in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Jysstev Estate
sub_locations.description: The two-floor estate of the [[Jysstev]] family.{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Roenall Estate
sub_locations.description: The home of the noble [[Roenall]] family.{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Vulova Estate
sub_locations.description: A smaller mansion of the [[Vulova]] family, built next door to the [[Temple of Waukeen (Athkatla)|Temple of Waukeen]].{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Galvarey Estate
sub_locations.description: A large bright noble estate, in reality, a fortified [[Harper]] hold, guarded by [[Spectral Harpist]] and numerous Harper agents.{{approx}}

sub_locations.name: Ophal Estate
sub_locations.description: The estate of the [[Ophal]] merchant family that dealt in [[salt]], [[pepper]], and [[herb]]s.

sub_locations.name: House of Darastiir Thalongal
sub_locations.description: Home of merchant and a fleet owner [[Darastiir Thalongal]] who dealt in smuggling mercenaries, slaves, and weaponry in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: House of Malareetha Narindryn
sub_locations.description: The home of so-called "Lady Stargowns", [[Malareetha Narindryn]] – a socialite and filthy rich investor into Athkathlan business in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Baerlbohun House
sub_locations.description: The mansion of the [[Baerlbohun]] family, just as gaudy as the [[Baerlbohun Towers]].

sub_locations.name: House of Jalasra Fourwynds
sub_locations.description: Home of the retired adventurer and an information broker [[Jalasra Fourwynds]] who dabbled in investments in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: Hallowturrets House
sub_locations.description: One of the oldest vast mansions in the Gem District and home of the [[Hawkyns]] noble family. It was well-liked by the locals and illuminated by a plethora of lanterns.

sub_locations.name: House of Velrack Worthgar
sub_locations.description: Home of the wealthy retired sea captain and investor [[Velrack Worthgar]] in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

sub_locations.name: House of Tholondor Ivryn
sub_locations.description: Home of the [[Sage]] of [[Athkatla]], [[Tholondor Ivryn]]. The expert in the mercantile history of [[Amn]], genealogy, and investments.

sub_locations.name: House of Darsarl Rastable
sub_locations.description: Home of [[Darsarl Rastable]], a duelist for hire and an investor.
